name: Form Sterilizer
implementation_notes: Mirrors FormCpoDispatchView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, sectioned form body, dirty-tracking Back confirm, Pause/Clear/Simpan footer actions) but WITHOUT the grid/N-column/time-slot-uniqueness concept AND without a per-row event_date column — Log Siklus is a free event log, rows added manually via 'Tambah baris' with no upper bound, all rows sharing the header's single Date

Duration (Minutes) computed client-side (open_door_time - close_door_time, wrapping across midnight) via the exported computeDurationMinutes() helper in sterilizerRecordRepo.ts, reused identically by both FormSterilizerView.vue (live preview, rendered as a disabled/non-editable <input> showing the computed value) and the repo's own applyDetailRowChanges() (value persisted locally) — but the SERVER (SterilizerRecordService::computeDurationMinutes()) always recomputes and overrides this value on save/update, never trusting the client-persisted one, per entity-catalog: duration_minutes 'BUKAN kolom yang diinput user secara langsung'

Hapus baris follows the queue-for-deletion pattern (a row with an existing id is queued in pendingDeletionIds, only actually DELETEd by the repo on the next Simpan/Pause call) — consistent with Form CPO Dispatch/Kernel Dispatch/Solid Waste Disposal

checked_by_spv is a simple per-row boolean (not a user reference). Since 2026-10-04 (user decision) it is role-gated: rendered as <input type="checkbox"> bound via v-model ONLY for Supervisor (v-if="isSupervisor", data-testid detail-checked-by-spv-{index}); every other role sees a <span class="spv-check-text"> showing 'Ya'/'—' (data-testid detail-checked-by-spv-text-{index}), not a disabled input. The header's Checked By/Acknowledged By are likewise rendered ONLY for their entitled role (v-if="isSupervisor" / v-if="isMillManagement") and hidden, not disabled, for every other role

8 time-type detail fields (close_door_time, peak_1_time, exhaust_1_time, peak_2_time, exhaust_2_time, peak_3_time, exhaust_3_time, open_door_time) all rendered as <input type="time"> — only close_door_time and open_door_time carry data-testid selectors (the two fields the Duration computation and its tests depend on), the other 6 are plain, matching CPO Dispatch's convention of only tagging fields with test-relevant behavior
This is the FINAL station of this project (18th and last of the 18 canonical stations, promoted 2026-09-01)

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormSterilizerView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('sterilizer_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/sterilizer-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Kegagalan offline/5xx diam; penolakan 4xx (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03 di bawah), dan pada sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('sterilizer', mill, date) di SterilizerRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Endpoint stasiun ini (POST /api/sterilizer-records) adalah yang dipakai langsung oleh skenario mobile-menyusul di KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts (hasil {synced, rejection} write-through).

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave('sterilizer_record') mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; bila server menolak dengan 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED, usecase-141) rejection berisi pesan server dan FormSterilizerView membuka ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label kosong) 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' berisi pesan tersebut, lalu bernavigasi ke Monitor Sterilizer saat ditutup (tombol 'Mengerti' maupun klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal dan dapat dikirim ulang lewat sinkron Station List setelah masalahnya diselesaikan. Offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap diam. Cakupan test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts (generik, termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED → rejection berisi pesan); tidak ada test komponen khusus untuk form ini — test komponen representatif ada di mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts.

REVISI 2026-10-03 (e2e): spec Playwright mobile/tests/e2e/form-sterilizer.spec.ts ditulis (13 test) dan lulus dalam run penuh suite Playwright mobile (727 lulus / 0 gagal, 65 spec). Penulisan spec e2e stasiun ini menemukan cacat aplikasi di repo yang dipakai form ini: todayDateString() di mobile/src/services/sterilizerRecordRepo.ts memakai new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) (UTC) untuk kolom date pada createDraft, sehingga draft yang dibuat pukul 00:00–06:59 WIB mendapat tanggal kemarin — tanggal itu yang tampil dan disimpan form, hilang dari 'Hari Ini' Monitor, tersembunyi oleh filter default hari ini di Data Preview, dan terkirim ke server (write-through/sinkron) dengan tanggal yang salah sehingga dinilai kunci periode pada hari yang salah. Kini memakai tanggal lokal (getFullYear/getMonth/getDate), selaras dengan view Data Preview dan getTodaySummary (date('now','localtime')). Uji regresi: vitest 'mengisi tanggal draft dengan tanggal lokal, bukan UTC (dini hari WIB)' di mobile/tests/sterilizerRecordRepo.spec.ts (merah sebelum perbaikan, hijau sesudahnya) dan uji e2e 'New Data dini hari ...' di mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-sterilizer.spec.ts (sebelumnya fixme, kini lulus).

REVISI 2026-10-04 (penyeragaman checkbox verifikasi, keputusan user): checkbox header Checked By dan Acknowledged By di mobile/src/views/FormSterilizerView.vue kini HANYA dirender untuk peran yang berhak — Checked By dengan v-if="isSupervisor", Acknowledged By dengan v-if="isMillManagement" — seragam dengan konvensi 2026-09-14 form stasiun lain. Sebelumnya keduanya tampil untuk semua peran dan disabled bagi peran yang tidak berhak. Test disesuaikan: vitest mobile/tests/FormSterilizerView.spec.ts ('Checked By checkbox is not rendered for a non-supervisor role' — juga memastikan Acknowledged By tidak dirender; baru: 'Acknowledged By checkbox is rendered (and Checked By is not) for a mill_management role'; skenario supervisor kini juga memastikan Acknowledged By tidak dirender) dan e2e mobile/tests/e2e/form-sterilizer.spec.ts (toBeDisabled → toHaveCount(0); jumlah spec tetap 13). Hasil run gabungan 4 form (Sterilizer/CPO Dispatch/Kernel Dispatch/Solid Waste Disposal): 60/60 e2e dan 57/57 vitest lulus. Angka test_results tidak diubah.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): (1) 'Checked by SPV' per baris hanya Supervisor — FormSterilizerView.vue merender checkbox v-if="isSupervisor", peran lain melihat teks 'Ya'/'—'; server backend/app/Services/SterilizerRecordService.php upsertDetails() mengabaikan nilai dari aktor non-Supervisor (baris lama dipertahankan, baris baru false), bukan menolak. Cakupan: mobile/tests/FormSterilizerView.spec.ts (it.each operator/mill_management/admin → teks; supervisor → checkbox bisa diubah), mobile/tests/e2e/form-sterilizer.spec.ts ('Checked by SPV — hanya Supervisor yang dapat mengubah, Operator melihat teks'; fillCompleteRow kini opsi checkSpv), backend/tests/Feature/AuditFix20261004Test.php ('[spv] ...'). (2) sterilizerRecordRepo.createDraft() kini memakai todayLocalDateString() bersama (mobile/src/utils/localDate.ts) — helper lokal todayDateString() dihapus; normalisasi data lama ISO UTC oleh localSchema (mobile/tests/localDate.sqljs.spec.ts). (3) label catatan 'Note' → 'Catatan' id field-note (mobile/tests/noteLabelConsistency.spec.ts; e2e memakai getByLabel('Catatan')). (4) write-through aktif sungguhan (millSettingRepo SELECT immediate_sync_enabled), syncService menyimpan sync_error dan memakai Production Line stasiun record (mobile/tests/millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts, writeThroughSync.spec.ts, syncService.sqljs.spec.ts). (5) ConfirmDialog di-teleport ke <body> (mobile/tests/DialogTeleport.spec.ts). (6) Kosmetik header: ikon brand + ikon hamburger/tutup SVG ber-aria-label; tombol Pause bergaya action-button--warning. Angka test_results tidak diubah.
